fields.title: PHASE 5 — Re-run rules
fields.md:
- Regular issues run on the second day of each month in the morning (KST), plus measurement-layer event issues (quarterly and annual reports, holdings statements, detection of ad hoc disclosures, arrival of an expected trigger date). If the observation gap exceeds one month, the measurement layer launches the monthly issue on its own (protocol: source prompts/monthly_run.md).
- Re-runs begin with 'what changed since the last issue', and probabilities are adjusted only through R1–R6. If the same axis misses three times in a row, a forced re-estimate applies (rule source: prompts/berkshire_master.md).
- Management statements (below) are recorded only as milestone candidates: Abel, 'the insurance environment is getting tougher and is expected to soften through year-end' (2026-05-02 annual meeting, cited in [Forbes](https://www.forbes.com/sites/bill_stone/2026/11/07/berkshire-hathaway-q3-earnings-miss-on-insurance-not-on-strategy/)) · Buffett, 'the prices of many things will look very foolish, but that doesn't mean the investments are bad' (2026-05-02, [CNBC transcript](https://pressroom.versantmedia.com/cnbc/press-releases/cnbc-transcript-berkshire-hathaway-chairman-warren-buffett-sits-down-cnbcs)).
